paragraphs: Rav Mari bar Mar said: Mar Ukva said: Shemuel said, Yevamot 76a. R. Abba sent to him: Ask Rav Huna, Bava Kamma 96a. R. Abba bar Zavda sent to Mari bar Mar: Ask Rav Huna, etc. Meanwhile Rav Huna died; Rabbah his son told him: Thus my father said, etc.; and 'our teachers, Rav Ḥama bar Gurya, and our colleague Rav Ḥisda,' Gittin 86b. Mari bar Mari—should read Mar—Bava Batra 91a. Rav Ḥisda said: Mari bar Mar expounded, Eruvin 21a, several statements, and Sanhedrin 38a. Rabbah bar Naḥmani sent to Mari bar Mar by Abaye's hand, Megillah 7b.
